name: Jarvis
tagline: A voice-driven assistant for your Mac, powered by Claude, that talks back in French and acts on your apps.
description: Jarvis is a voice assistant that lives in your menu bar as a glowing orb. Speak to it and it answers out loud in French, powered by Claude, and acts on your Mac: files, apps, windows, the web. It remembers what you told it and what it already did.
